set.body:
Outcome: expose interpretable relations between contour pieces, with evidence beyond their marginal histograms.

Scope: graph nodes for endpoints/junctions and explicit incident contour spans; relationships for connectivity, closure/enclosure under declared domain rules, good continuation across gaps, and parallel pairs with separation/shared extent. Preserve original contour IDs and specify self-crossing/overlap handling separately from legacy distinct-contour junction detection. Reuse existing geometry where its contract fits; avoid changing mlv2023 junction behavior implicitly. Graph measures carry the feature specification and tolerance units.

Acceptance:
- Pass the frozen matched-marginal generator and independent small graph/topology expectations.
- Distinguish the predefined spatial-organization pairs without exploiting uncontrolled histogram differences; include negative controls and perturbation boundaries.
- Verify transformations, edge identity, and geometry/specification invalidation, plus public serialization/tabular use.
- Document geometric relations as evidence only: T-junctions do not by themselves prove border ownership, and straightness does not prove global reflection symmetry.
- Retain exact source/fixture evidence and bound runtime on representative synthetic graphs. Any additional descriptor or predictive-validity claim requires separate evidence and scope.
set.title: Implement contour relationship graphs and a bounded descriptor set
